mentions.name: pgqueuer
mentions.description: This tool turns a vanilla PostgreSQL database into a horizontally-scalable job queue, requiring zero additional infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Teams running Postgres want to ditch maintaining separate queue clusters for job processing.
mentions.audience: Developers and operators already running PostgreSQL who need background job processing without extra queue infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt: pgqueuer turns vanilla PostgreSQL into horizontally-scalable job queue with zero extra infrastructure. If you’re running Postgres and want to ditch extra queue clusters, give it a spin and let me know how it holds up.
